channel.title: Hamid Reza Ashkiyan — Engineering Blog
channel.description: Backend architecture and distributed systems notes on .NET 10, Clean Architecture, DDD, RabbitMQ Quorum Queues, and MassTransit.

item.title: Migrating 15+ Production Services to Modern .NET & RabbitMQ Quorum Queues
item.description: Field notes on upgrading legacy .NET services without downtime, transitioning RabbitMQ classic queues to quorum queues with MassTransit, and tuning SQL Server stored procedures.

item.title: Structuring Modular Monoliths with Clean Architecture, MediatR & MassTransit
item.description: How to design loosely coupled modules with independent persistence, strict contract boundaries, and asynchronous event buses before jumping prematurely to microservices.

item.title: Eliminating Dual-Write Hazards: Transactional Outbox Pattern in .NET & RabbitMQ
item.description: Why database commits combined with direct message publishing fail in production, and how to implement a bulletproof transactional outbox with polling workers or CDC.

item.title: Designing Bulletproof Idempotent Consumers in Distributed Systems
item.description: Network retries and broker reconnects inevitably lead to duplicate messages. Here is how we design zero-duplicate consumer pipelines with inbox tables and Redis locks.

item.title: Distributed Tracing & Correlation IDs Across 20+ Microservices
item.description: How to trace a single user request flowing through API gateways, messaging queues, and background processors without losing the correlation trail.
